triggers.name: certificate_marketing_copy_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER certificate_marketing_copy_guard BEFORE INSERT ON public."DestructionCertificate" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION require_marketing_copy_erasure()

triggers.name: marketing_local_copy_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER marketing_local_copy_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON public."Job" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_marketing_local_copy()

functions.name: guard_marketing_local_copy
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_marketing_local_copy()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD."localCopyErasedAt" IS NOT NULL AND NEW."localCopyErasedAt" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."localCopyErasedAt"
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'local erasure evidence is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: require_marketing_copy_erasure
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_marketing_copy_erasure()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Job" WHERE "marketingSubmissionId"=NEW."submissionId" AND "localCopyErasedAt" IS NULL)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'certificate requires local delivery copy erasure' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
